title: Downloads contain the shown columns in screen order (Total Cost last), honor all filters and the sort, and include a "Totals" row matching the full-set totals
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report is open with a non-default column selection, a Category or Vendor filter, a part search, and a non-default sort applied.
steps: 1. Download the current view as a CSV and open it.
2. Compare its columns and their order to the screen.
3. Compare its rows to the current filters, search, and sort.
4. Compare its totals row to the on-screen totals row.
5. Repeat the checks in the PDF.
expected: 1. Both downloads include only the columns currently shown, in the same left-to-right order as the screen, with Total Cost last.
2. Both downloads honor the current date, category, vendor, location, and part-search filters, and apply the current sort.
3. Both downloads include a totals row labeled "Totals" matching the on-screen totals (the full-filtered-set totals).
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
spec_ref: specs/inventory-value.md Story 10 S10-R3; S10-R4; S10-R5; S10-R6
notes: Note the on-screen totals row is labeled "Total" (S4-R1) while the export totals row is labeled "Totals" (S10-R6) — both verbatim in the spec; VIU-confirm.
